snippet.title: Gaelic Football Laochra | Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Gaelic Football is coming to Steam.

Our Steam page for Gaelic Football Laochra is now live. Watch the trailer and wishlist the game now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3115530/Gaelic_Football_Laochra/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=steam_page_launch

Bring the speed, physicality and atmosphere of Gaelic Football to your wishlist.

More Soon…™

Music: Dúlamán by Huartan
